component.name: Kodi: Blu-ray Java menus (BD-J)
component.summary: Java runtime for Blu-ray disc menus

description.p: Adds the Java runtime and libbluray support classes that Kodi needs to play the interactive BD-J menus found on many Blu-ray discs. Without it such discs still play, but Kodi falls back to the simple disc menu.
This extension is optional and fairly large, so it is not installed automatically. Install it only if you play Blu-ray discs or disc images.
